visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a pitch-black night sky, which is suddenly illuminated by a large explosion of fireworks on the right side of the frame. Brilliant white and pale yellow sparks radiate outwards in a spherical pattern, leaving glowing trails that slowly descend and dissipate into the darkness. There are no people, objects, or identifiable settings visible other than the empty night sky. (2) A rapid series of smaller pyrotechnic bursts follows in quick succession, filling the right side of the frame with a chaotic web of golden-white streaks. The camera remains static, capturing the varying textures of the sparks as they bloom and fade. The lighting is provided entirely by the flashes of the fireworks themselves, creating a high-contrast environment. (3) The display continues with high-density bursts that create a bright, shimmering focal point against the black void. In the final moments, a lower-altitude explosion releases greenish-white sparks that spread wider across the horizon. The light trails eventually lose their intensity and vanish, returning the screen to total darkness with no visible remnants or buildings in the background.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A deep, pitch-black night sky with no buildings, trees, or geographical landmarks visible. The only visual elements are the light and smoke trails produced by the fireworks.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a series of sharp, resonant percussive thuds that represent the detonation of firework shells. Each bang is followed by a crisp, high-frequency sizzling sound as the sparks ignite. No background music or voices are audible, ensuring a high-fidelity focus on the pyrotechnic SFX. (2) A dense sequence of overlapping pops and explosions follows, creating an irregular but frantic percussive rhythm. The spectral bandwidth is wide, featuring deep-frequency thumps and bright, broadband noise from the burning chemical trails. The intensity is constant with no variation in volume between the events. (3) A final, loud and particularly deep-frequency boom dominates the mix, signaling a larger finale burst. This is followed by a prolonged, decaying crackling texture that slowly fades out over several seconds. The background noise floor is minimal, resulting in a pristine recording of the explosion events.
